headline: Anmol India Confirms Full Demat Compliance Under SEBI Regulation 74(5)
hook: Routine regulatory filing by Anmol India
summary: Anmol India has confirmed its full compliance with the dematerialisation requirements under SEBI Regulation 74(5). This is a routine procedural filing required for listed companies to ensure shares are properly held in electronic form. There is no direct financial impact or operational shift reported from this update. Retail investors holding the stock face no immediate change to their holdings or company fundamentals.
why_it_matters: No material impact on company fundamentals or stock value
